page.layout: One column of numbered questions, with italic references after many of them, in reading order top to bottom. Three centred capitalised section headings (ANATOMICA., PATHOLOGICA., THERAPEVTICA.) divide the column. Signature and catchword at the foot. No margin notes and no running head.

main_text.p: 23. Respiratio voluntatis'ne an Naturalis actio di-[?]cenda?
main_text.head: ANATOMICA.
main_text.p: 24. Utrum dextrum, an vero siniftrum latus corporis sit calidius? Ariftot. & contra illum Neoterici,3. de part. an.4.
25. Dentes utrum sentiant, & proprio afficiantur dolore? Neoterico[?]r sententia.
26. An Vrachos detur in foetu humano?
27. Menstruus sanguis an expurgetur per uterum? Vesal.sent.
Et utrum Foetus nutriatur menstruo sanguine?
28. Medulla ossibus Leonum an insit? Arift.3. de hiftor.an.7.20.2.depart.an.6.Vide Columb. Anatomes l.1.c.19.
main_text.head: PATHOLOGICA.
main_text.p: 29. An nullum animal, nisi homo, calculosum fieri pofsit? Arift.10 proble.24.Merc.
30. Herniæ utrum fiant Peritonæo difrupto, an verò tantummodo relaxato? Fernel.Hollerius Morb.intern.l.1.c.62.
31. An nullus in Corde morbus confistere pofsit?
32. An Hippocrates recte omnes morbos ulcera dixerit? lib.de Fract.3.
33. Lues Venerea utrum veteribus fuerit cognita?
main_text.head: THERAPEVTICA.
main_text.p: 34. An ulcera Pulmonis curari nequeant? Francif.Arcaus Chirurg.lib.2.
35. Inflammationes utrum frigefacientibus an calefacientibus recte curentur? Nicol.Cusanus, sed ante illum Arift.in Probl.
36. Utrum Medicameto purganti præmittenda venæsectio, vel contrà? D.Cornax Cosult.med.lib.2.c.31.

page.notes: Section headings are set as centred capitals and are given level 2 as parts of the list. Doubtful readings: "di-" at the line end of item 23 (hyphen and following letters unclear), "voluntatis'ne" (apostrophe-like mark), "Neoterico[?]r" (the glyph before "r" is unclear), "Arcaus" (ligature unclear, possibly Arcæus). "pofsit" and "pofsit" are transcribed as printed. The mark in "Vrachos" is kept as printed.
